subject: TimeScale interpretation
evidence: The value that TimeScaleUpdate publishes (stfs to 0x803EA2C4 at 0x80028DB8) is stored only by this unit (stfs at 0x80028D0C and 0x80028DB8; its other 54 references are lfs). Its .sdata initial value is 1.0. Readers use it as a per-frame time multiplier. 0x8004B924 computes value * (1/60) + field (fmadds; 0x3C888889 loaded from 0x8028D7D8) and stores the result back. 0x80027D24 divides 60.0 (from 0x8028A058) by it to form a frame count. 0x80096CD4-0x80096CE0 adds it to the float at +0x24 of an object and stores the sum back. fn_8006CCA8 receives the same value, multiplies it by 4096.0 (from 0x80290698), converts it with fctiwz and stores the integer to 0x803EA690 (stw at 0x8006CCC4). "Time scale" and the TimeScale prefix describe this observed use and are not recovered names. 0x803EA2C4 lies outside this unit's .sdata, between data of earlier units, so it keeps its neutral label lbl_803EA2C4. The float is owned by the accepted src/game/MainLoop.cpp unit; its original name and semantic identity remain unresolved, and the time-scale interpretation is inferred.

subject: TimeScaleUpdate condition
evidence: The clamp test is written (sStep > 0.0f && sCurrent >= sTarget) || (sStep < 0.0f && sCurrent <= sTarget). With the game_cpp flags its De Morgan form, its swapped-operand form (0.0f < sStep) and its negated form compile to the same instructions, so it is one of several equivalent forms. The sign tests reuse cr7 from the zero test at 0x80028D58. The clamp copies sTarget into sCurrent (f12, stfs at 0x80028DA4) and zeroes the step before publishing.

subject: TimeScaleSet and TimeScaleRamp
evidence: TimeScaleSet passes its f1 argument unchanged with f2 = 0.0 to TimeScaleRamp (bl at 0x80028DE4). If the f2 argument is 0.0 or sCurrent equals the target, TimeScaleRamp stores the target to sTarget and sCurrent and 1.0 to sStep, then returns. It does not publish: the non-zero step makes the next TimeScaleUpdate add it, clamp to the equal target and publish. Otherwise sStep = target / f2 (fdivs f2,f1,f2 at 0x80028E2C; the quotient uses the target itself, not its difference from sCurrent). sTarget = target, and the step is negated (reloaded at 0x80028E60) when its sign points away from the target. The names target and divisor describe these uses; what callers pass as the divisor is not established. Source assigns sCurrent before sTarget; the compiler emits the sTarget store first (0x80028D1C before 0x80028D24, 0x80028E18 before 0x80028E20), and the reverse source order emits sCurrent first.
